items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Vernon was with the house band there, and in the house band --

ctx.x: At the Renaissance -- we'd be up to the Renaissance Casino. That's where he had -- was stationed there, used to play all the big basketball games and big clubs, a lot of big, negro old clubs like the Cosmopolitans Club, big (unintelligible) clubs and Vernon was with the house band there, and in the house band --
